command: set -eo pipefail; export HF_TOKEN="$(cat "$MEGATOKEN_CW_SECRETS/hf-token")"; command -v ffmpeg >/dev/null || (apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq ffmpeg >/dev/null); mkdir -p /work/out/dynamic-resources; python scripts/acquire_packs.py --root /work/out/dynamic-resources/packs > /work/out/dynamic-resources/acquisition.json; python scripts/verify_packs.py --manifest /work/out/dynamic-resources/packs/lock.json --rollout --prepare > /work/out/dynamic-resources/decoder-verification.json
